summary: CoreWeave filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a private offering of $1.25 billion (USD) 9.625% Senior Notes due 2032 and €2.0 billion 8.500% Senior Notes due 2032, issued under indentures with U.S. Bank Trust. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment and fees. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by certain subsidiaries. Redemption prior to July 15, 2029 requires a make-whole premium. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No deal terms such as price per share or premium are applicable; the filing is a standard current report on a debt issuance.
